title: Bianchi-I Cosmology with Radiation in Asymptotically Safe Gravity
authors: Chiang-Mei Chen; Ting-Kui Fan; Rituparna Mandal; Nobuyoshi Ohta

limitation: Equation-level RG improvement with assumed traceless extra stress is not QED renormalization; electric-magnetic duality excludes electrically charged pair-current dynamics.
